description: Java source code for the ReportsApiResource class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing reports in the Fineract platform, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting reports.

classes.name: ReportsApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for report management, providing endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting reports.

methods.name: retrieveReportList
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all reports with their parameters.

methods.name: retrieveReport
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific report by ID, optionally including a template.

methods.name: retrieveOfficeTemplate
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a report template with default data for UI building.

methods.name: createReport
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new report based on provided JSON data.

methods.name: updateReport
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing report's details.

methods.name: deleteReport
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a non-core report by ID.
